laws.rule: Miyajima Visitor Tax (Hatsukaichi City): ¥100 (about A$0.90 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per visit, or ¥500 for a year. It is collected with the ferry fare; preschool children are exempt.
laws.heading: Miyajima visitor tax

laws.rule: Hiroshima Prefecture's accommodation tax (shukuhaku-zei) started on 1 April 2026: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) where the room-only charge is JPY 6,000 or more before tax (about A$54.14); stays under JPY 6,000 are not taxed. School trips are exempt with a principal's certificate given to the lodging by the day before. It covers hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku (registered private home stays) and is paid at the lodging.
laws.heading: 宿泊税に関するお知らせ

laws.rule: Hiroshima City sets smoking restriction zones (kitsuen seigen kuiki) in the city centre under its anti-littering ordinance: in outdoor public places there (roads, parks, plazas, riverbanks) smoking is banned except at ashtrays the manager has set up, including with a portable ashtray and including heated tobacco. The fine is JPY 1,000 (about A$9.02, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). The outdoor area of the Peace Memorial Park has been fully smoke-free since 1 April 2018.
laws.heading: 広島市ぽい捨て等の防止に関する条例

laws.rule: Hiroshima Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (広島県青少年健全育成条例), art. 42. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 6 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

festivals.what: Kangensai (Itsukushima Shrine, Miyajima): held on the 17th day of the 6th lunar month, so the date moves each year (30 July in 2026). A boat festival on the sea; related rites fall on lunar 6/10 and 6/11. The shrine's Chinkasai fire rite is on 31 December.
